prompt: In the blackness of the deep sea, a small, one-person submersible is hovering in front of a giant anglerfish. The anglerfish's bioluminescent lure is dangling directly above its head and is the brightest object in the scene. The anglerfish is opening its massive jaw towards the submersible. The submersible has its powerful headlights pointing at the anglerfish, and these headlights are brighter than the glow from a nearby school of shrimp. The submersible has two robotic arms; one is extended and holding a sensor probe, pointing the probe at the anglerfish's eye. The small school of glowing shrimp is swimming between the submersible and the anglerfish. The number of shrimp is three times the number of the submersible's robotic arms. A giant squid is behind the anglerfish, partially hidden in the darkness. The squid is wrapping a tentacle around a piece of a shipwreck on the seafloor. The submersible is facing the anglerfish. The anglerfish's eye is larger than the sensor probe at the end of the robotic arm. The squid is looking at the submersible. The shipwreck is under the anglerfish.
